name: Villamediana de Iregua (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a saltire of blue and yellow, the bend blue and the bend sinister yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Villamediana de Iregua; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly
bend sinister from the lower hoist to the upper fly
